```plato

    //==
    // # Catmull-Rom basis
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline#Catmull-Rom_spline
    // Four control values; the segment runs from p1 (t=0) to p2 (t=1), with the
    // tangents taken from the neighbours p0 and p3 (uniform parameterization).
    //   CR(t) = 0.5 * [ 2*p1 + (p2 - p0)*t
    //                 + (2*p0 - 5*p1 + 4*p2 - p3)*t^2
    //                 + (3*p1 - p0 - 3*p2 + p3)*t^3 ]

    // The uniform Catmull-Rom segment at t, interpolating p1 to p2.
    CatmullRom(p0: INumerical, p1: INumerical, p2: INumerical, p3: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => (p1 * 2.0
          + (p2 - p0) * t
          + (p0 * 2.0 + p2 * 4.0 - p1 * 5.0 - p3) * t.Square
          + (p1 * 3.0 + p3 - p0 - p2 * 3.0) * (t.Square * t)) * 0.5;
```
